title: OpenAI hires Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new Creator Product division
summary: OpenAI has hired Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new "Creator Product" division. After more than 13 years at the creator platform, he's bringing two Patreon executives with him. The team will build new tools for creators, and a first look could come at OpenAI DevDay next week. The article OpenAI hires Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new Creator Product division appeared first on The Decoder .
